findings.evidence: template/scripts/select_checks.py:599 wraps the entire freshness gate in `requires_task_freshness(checks)`. That predicate (lines 255–260) accepts only protected-full, high-impact-path and unknown-path selection reasons, excluding ordinary mapped checks. Consequently, mapped selections reach execute without currency classification and with base_contract=None. The active delta's scenario “Coordinator candidate behind a disjoint main is handed off without reconcile” requires evidence-producing selected checks to name and record the contract; its overlapping-main scenario requires those checks to stop before execution. design.md decision 2 likewise applies the exception to --evidence in local-affected mode without limiting it to full selections.
findings.summary: Evidence-producing validation applies the new contract only to full-check selections. Narrow coordinator selections neither record behind-disjoint evidence nor block overlapping main changes.
